expectations.text: Opens with a hook rather than throat-clearing scene-setting
expectations.evidence: "This year's Christmas drama rehearsals at church started with a small letdown. I auditioned for one of the lead roles, walked in with a version of the character already forming in my head, and then found out I'd been cast as a side character instead." -- expository scene-setting rather than a direct admission-first hook.

expectations.text: Admits the initial disappointment plainly, without over-apologizing
expectations.evidence: "I won't pretend I wasn't a bit disappointed. I was." -- admits it, though wrapped in more hedging framing ('I won't pretend...') than Asher's plainer style.

expectations.text: Contains at least one H2 header phrased as a question
expectations.evidence: No H2 headers anywhere -- single title, continuous prose throughout.

expectations.text: Includes the improvised-line anecdote with concrete specific detail
expectations.evidence: "I had exactly one line. One. And when the moment came, it just wasn't there. Blank." -- concrete and specific.

expectations.text: Ending is a genuine reflective callback rather than a generic moral-of-the-story wrap-up
expectations.evidence: "There's something fitting about that whole arc -- going in wanting the part I didn't get, resenting the smaller role for a beat, and then having the smaller role hand me the best moment..." -- interpretive metadiscourse narrating the arc's meaning rather than a sharp callback to one planted image.

expectations.text: Does not contain banned buzzwords or invented fake-profound kicker phrasing
expectations.evidence: No literal banned-list words, though the title itself ('The Line I Forgot (And Why the Director Wants Me to Keep Forgetting It)') is an embellished hook not grounded in the given material.

expectations.text: Uses short paragraphs and at least one deliberate fragment or ellipsis
expectations.evidence: Paragraphs run 3-6 sentences each with no section breaks; only two isolated fragments ('One.' 'Blank.') amid otherwise continuous prose.

eval_feedback.overall: Same pattern as the other two baselines: no section headers, longer uniform paragraphs, and a tendency toward interpretive metadiscourse at the close instead of a sharp callback.
